2226-2805-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2805-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kiri-Onna by paying its mana cost.
When Kiri-Onna enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

3510-4288-4875-8168.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Conspiracy.
3510-4288-4875-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Conspiracy and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

539-1462-3821-4679-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-1462-3821-4679-5686.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, creating a Blood token.
Repeat

512-3990-4091.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce {W}.
Incubation Druid and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-3990-4091.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Incubation Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-3990-4091.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Incubation Druid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1339-1832-2034-3025.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-3025.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

4659-4694-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4659-4694-5805-7306.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Repeat from step 1.

64-5531-5694-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
64-5531-5694-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Warden of the Eye and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Warden of the Eye and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
64-5531-5694-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Warden of the Eye and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

671-1957-4050--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
When that creature enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2907-3899-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, each Scute Swarm triggers, creating that many creature tokens.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

225-751-3257-3314.easyPrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to add {U}.
225-751-3257-3314.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2811-4399-4770-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Elas il-Kor trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2811-4399-4770-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1430-1619-4264.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1430-1619-4264.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Mirror Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1430-1619-4264.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

628-5256-7214.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1477-1726-6972.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

3165-3532-3836-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-3836-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3470-5702-6763-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3470-5702-6763-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-5143-5711.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
1978-5143-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Fanatic of Rhonas.
Repeat

625-1978-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 3 or greater.
625-1978-6478.description:
Cause Arbor Adherent to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat from step 2.

4195-4574-4708-6900.description:
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Resolve the Dark Sphere ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Dark Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3967-4871-6010--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the persist creature trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure token enters the battlefield, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3591-5435-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
3591-5435-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
3591-5435-5796-6282.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Repeat.

224-1772-3478-3875.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

478-804-1460-2821-4832.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
478-804-1460-2821-4832.description:
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-943-5873.description:
Activate Everglades by tapping it, adding {C}{B}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Everglades.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Everglades.
Repeat.
74-943-5873.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Everglades instead.

1545-2919-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
1545-2919-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Trostani, Selesnya's Voice triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

433-1323-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Llanowar Scout each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
433-1323-4543.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Llanowar Scout's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Experiment Kraj.
Repeat.

851-3340-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
851-3340-3542.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, creating twelve Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate eleven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {7}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat.

396-3487-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
396-3487-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Aetherstorm Roc and Blessed Sanctuary.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
The Unicorn enters the battlefield, triggering Aetherstorm Roc.
Resolve both Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

261-1371-2067.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Storm Herd.
Resolve the first opponent's Storm Herd, causing them to create a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to their life total.
Each Pegasus enters the battlefield, triggering Suture Priest's second ability that many times, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the number of Pegasus that entered the battlefield.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Storm Herd.

116-618.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a token copy of Kiora's Follower with haste.
Tap the Kiora's Follower token to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat for infinite ETB and tapped creature tokens with haste.

45-1309-1987-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
45-1309-1987-3075.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
